editorial:
Imagine starting out as a total outsider who suddenly finds himself in the middle of a secret world of elite ninjas. That is exactly what happens to you when you follow the journey of Snake Eyes. He is a tough guy with a mysterious past who saves the life of a clan leader's son, which earns him a spot in the Arashikage clan. You get to see him go from a raw fighter to a disciplined warrior in beautiful Japanese settings. The vibe is very much like a comic book come to life, focusing on honor, loyalty, and the struggle to find where you truly belong.

What really pops are the fight scenes and the cool gear, though the story feels a bit predictable at times. The action is snappy, and while the plot is simple, it keeps you moving along. If you love martial arts and flashy battles, you will have a blast.
endingExplained: At the end, Snake Eyes discovers that Koga is the real traitor who wanted to take over the clan. After a massive final fight, Snake Eyes defeats Koga and proves his loyalty to the Arashikage family. He finally earns his place as a true ninja. The movie wraps up with him fully embracing his identity, setting the stage for him to eventually join the G.I. Joe team in the future.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves martial arts and comic book movies.
